_comment: ADR-0082 release security boundaries. Named real tests are statically mapped here; execution evidence and full lab release approval remain distinct.

invariants.rule: After all header merges, an initial off-origin target receives neither configured Authorization nor Cookie credentials, including cookie jars, upload, download and stream paths; same-origin credentials are retained.
invariants.why: Initial absolute URLs must receive the same origin protection as redirected URLs.
cases: final target credentials on every http path

invariants.rule: Forwarded host and protocol share the existing trusted proxy decision based on the actual transport peer. Ignore both from untrusted peers and honor both from a configured trusted proxy.
invariants.why: Client-controlled forwarded authority must not bypass raw-peer trust.
cases: forwarded host and proto share raw peer trust
